environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on ECS Fargate. MongoDB Atlas M10 cluster (shared tier) with default configuration. Application connects using a single database user 'app_user' with readWrite role on 'multitenant_app' database. No MongoDB query validation middleware. JWT tokens issued by Auth0 with tenantId claim. Network: application connects to Atlas via VPC peering with no additional query-layer filtering.

config.network: VPC peering to Atlas, no proxy
